writtenTo: The returned exiles in Jerusalem (520 BC)
importantNotes: Haggai's ministry lasted only about four months but was powerfully effective.
'Is it time for you to dwell in your paneled houses while this house lies in ruins?' (1:4).
The people obeyed Haggai's message — rare for a prophetic book.
'The glory of this latter house shall be greater than the former' (2:9) — fulfilled in Christ.
Haggai teaches that spiritual priorities must come before personal comfort.

chapters.1: Haggai rebukes the people for neglecting the Temple; they respond and begin rebuilding.
chapters.2: The future glory of the Temple; encouragement to Zerubbabel; God will shake the nations.
